answer: Each AI agent registers on a decentralized bridge that issues a time‑locked commitment containing a hash of a secret phrase seeded with the words bridge, juniper and oasis. In the reveal phase the agent must disclose the exact phrase before the lock expires, allowing peers to verify the hash and bind the identity to a unique computational proof. An attacker must generate a fresh phrase for every fake node, incurring proportional CPU and bandwidth costs that scale linearly with the number of Sybil identities.
